name: recommend
summary: Fixed-output deterministic fixture: turn one deterministic document analysis into the final approval recommendation.
description: Final step of the canonical doc-approval pipeline (spec 069): consumes the doc-approval.analyze@1.0.0 output and produces a deterministic recommendation, rationale, and confidence without model, network, randomness, or host state dependencies. IMPORTANT: this artifact is a fixed-output deterministic fixture -- it does not read or process its input at all; it always returns the same hardcoded recommendation/rationale/confidence values ("approve" / "analysis satisfies the governed threshold" / "high") regardless of the analysis fields provided. It is a genuine, real WASI binary (not a placeholder stub sharing a digest with unrelated capabilities), useful for proving the registry/artifact-hosting/execution pipeline end-to-end, but it does not perform real analysis on its input. Tracked follow-up for real per-input logic: registry#79.

preconditions.description: The caller provides the doc-approval.analyze output fields.

postconditions.description: The capability returns a fixed recommendation, rationale, and confidence value, identical for every call regardless of the analysis fields provided.

side_effects.description: Produces one deterministic recommendation payload for the provided analysis.
